name: AgentFury
description: Agent Fury: AI agent & assistant — ask about any text even where copying is blocked, read the text inside images, fix any text box.

action.default_title: AgentFury — click to open the side panel

toggle-privacy.description: Privacy mode — hide/show AgentFury's on-page UI everywhere

open-assistant.description: Open the AgentFury side panel (and warm up the server)

trigger-ask.description: Show the AgentFury bar on the page (asks about your selection)

snip-ocr.description: Snip & read — drag a box over anything on screen to pull its text out

force-copy.description: Copy anyway — copies the selection (or the text under the pointer) where the site blocks copying
